scope: Proposition 2.2 (Finite-volume criterion) of the manuscript “Sharp mass bounds for the two-dimensional O(4) model” (preprints/Sharp-mass-bounds-for-the-two-dimensional-O4-model-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 215 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e87f407df77777ca), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 11. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let n ≥ 4 be even. If ∆β(n) ≤ η∗ := 2−10 , (2.9) then the transfer operators on circumferences 2kn, k ≥ 0, satisfy λ2(2kn) λ1(2kn) ≤ e−(log 2)/n . (2.10) Every local limit of the square tori with sides 2kn has full gap at least (log 2)/n. In particular, if the periodic infinite-plane state is unique, then mlat(β) ≥ log 2 n . (2.11)
